messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: prod latency SLO breach — p99 streaming latency > 2.5s across us-west-2. Auto-triage flagged KV cache pressure on inference-nodes-6-*. Paging oncall.
morgan: on it. grabbing recent graphs now — more context pls from the dashboard link
ash: seeing spikes at ~16:02 UTC. p95 up ~800ms, p99 ~2.7s for streaming endpoints. throughput steady. no obvious error rate increase.
devin: echo. top traces show many requests stuck in `prefill` stage, decode queue is light. looks like prefill vs decode imbalance.
samira: interesting — decoded token latencies OK, but prefill tasks queue depth is super high on a subset of shards. might be KV cache eviction churn.
leo: I see repeated KV eviction logs on node inference-nodes-6-3: "evicting slab id=7 size=1.2GB" every 2-3s. prefill tries to fetch prefixes -> misses -> heavy disk reads -> tail stalls.
morgan: customer impact? any production tenants seeing errors or degraded responses?
ash: no 500s, just streaming stalls / longer first-byte times. a few customers reported slow chat responses (support ticket references #12345, #12346).
oncall-bot: Handoff request: morgan -> ash (next 2 hours). Confirming.
morgan: assigning ash as primary triager. devin, samira please assist on mitigation changes.
devin: initial mitigation thought: reduce prefill aggressiveness and increase in-memory eviction threshold for affected shard group. can toggle via feature flag: `prefill.dynamic_window=false` and bump `kv.slab_target_ratio`.
samira: we can also route new heavy requests away from the affected shard group (node pool shift) while we patch. Preparing routing rule now.
leo: prepping a rolling drain of inference-nodes-6-3 and inference-nodes-6-4 (most evict churn). will cordon and drain with `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets` to move workloads; expect ~30s graceful for streaming sessions.
ash: before draining, try soft mitigation: increase slab threshold to 0.85 on nodes 6-* to reduce eviction frequency.
morgan: runbook step triggered: `/runbook kv-cache-pressure` — following recommended quick actions.
devin: running command to set flag in prod-config:

```
PATCH https://config.internal/api/v1/flags
{
  "key": "kv.slab_target_ratio",
  "value": 0.85,
  "scope": "inference-nodes-6-*"
}
```

Applying now.
samira: routing change in-flight: adding temporary route to pool `inference-fallback-2` for requests with seq_length > 2048. rule pushed.
leo: cordon/drain started on node inference-nodes-6-3. moving 14 active streams off. watching stream reconnects.
ash: slab ratio change applied. monitoring eviction logs — frequency dropped, prefill queue depth decreasing.
devin: after flag: p95 reduced from 800ms -> 420ms over last 2 mins. p99 coming down from 2.7s -> 1.6s. good sign.
morgan: excellent. can we keep the routing rule and slab tweak as a mitigation while we investigate longer term? Need customer comms prepared.
samira: yes, keep both for now. starting deeper analysis on why fragmentation spiked: suspect workload shift with many mid-length sequences that fragment slabs.
leo: grabbing heap profiles and KV slab maps. snapshotting `/var/lib/kv/slabs/meta` from affected nodes.
ash: also enabling detailed decode/prefill tracing for a small sample: `trace_id=kv-prefill-sample-2026-03-15`.
devin: note: there's a known prefill vs decode imbalance issue when prefill misses cascade under high partial-key churn. filing a quick ticket: INF-5239.
morgan: create customer impact note draft: short message explaining slow streams for a subset of customers in US-WEST between 16:02-16:30 UTC, mitigation in progress, follow-up with RCA. tagging support.
oncall-bot: Reminder: mark incident severity if customer-visible impact > threshold. current impact: degraded UX (no errors) — Severity: SEV-2 suggested.
morgan: agreed SEV-2. Samira, please add to incident tracker and ping growth for any high-volume customers.
samira: done. tracker INF-2026-0315-KVFRAG. pinged account owners for 3 customers.
leo: logs + slab snapshots uploaded to internal S3: s3://redwood/ops/kv-frag/4512345678/
ash: next steps — scheduled follow-up: increase slab compaction frequency in runtime (config `kv.compact_interval=30s`), and evaluate moving to slab size 32MB from 16MB to reduce fragmentation. need change window.
devin: will run a canary with `kv.compact_interval=30s` on staging and one prod node after current drain completes.
morgan: status: keeping routing rule and slab tweak. p99 now ~1.2s trending down. continue monitoring for next 30m. filling postmortem template after stable.
samira: collecting all traces for RCA and preparing customer-facing timeline.
leo: draining finished on 6-3, unhealthy pods moved, nodes stable.
ash: rechecking streaming stalls — very few residuals, p95 ~300ms, p99 ~1.1s. recommend marking incident mitigated and moving to post-incident review.
morgan: copy. moving to mitigated state. ash -> take lead on RCA write-up. assign to devin+leo for follow-ups on compaction/slot-size experiments.
devin: noted. I'll open follow-up PRs and schedule perf run.
samira: closing loop with support: updated tickets with mitigation and ETA for RCA in 72hrs.
incident-bot: Incident status changed to MITIGATED by morgan. Auto-log created: INC-4512345678.

morgan: nice work team. postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause (kv slab fragmentation + prefill misses -> decode imbalance), mitigations (slab ratio bump, routing fallback, drains), follow-ups (compaction tuning, slab size change, longer-term routing safeguards). I'll start the doc.
